title: Refactor: what next after stage 2c
question: You approved stages 0 to 2c, and they're done and committed. They made the code checkable (reliable tests, pinned tools, formatting, lint, size and dependency gates, save/Continue fixed) but didn't split the big files: main.js 1720 lines, ui.js 1810, move.js 1461 (longer than before because the formatting pass put one statement per line). Splitting them is stages 3 to 5 of Codex's plan. What now?

options.label: Keep going: stages 3 to 5 now, in the same freeze
options.note: 3: audio and dialogue/portrait out of ui.js. 4: main.js hooks, interactions and place lifecycle. 5: movement and navigation out of move.js. Each step proven with before/after recordings. The queued game fixes (pins, outline, bag scene, train doors, click during Eric's word...) wait until it's done.

options.label: Release the freeze, do the queued fixes, then stages 3 to 5 in a new freeze
options.note: You get the visible fixes sooner; the split happens after, on top of them.

options.label: Stop here
options.note: Keep the gates and checks; no big-file split for now. Release the freeze and do the queued fixes.

decision: Keep going: stages 3 to 5 in the same freeze (Jørgen in chat, 2026-09-29)
